verses.1: And at that time, Yehuda came down from among his brothers. He became a leader among the people, and his name was Hiram.
verses.2: And there he saw a Canaanite woman, a daughter of a man from Canaan. Her name was Shua. He took her away with him.
verses.3: And she became pregnant and gave birth to a son. She named him Er.
verses.4: And she became pregnant again, and gave birth to a son. She named him O’nan.
verses.5: And she became pregnant again, and gave birth to a son. She named him Shelah. And he lived in Kziv after her death.
verses.6: And Judah took a wife for Er from Beeroth. Her name was Tamar.
verses.7: And there was a famine in Judah. It was a time of great suffering for the people of Judah. Jehovah suffered greatly because of this.
verses.8: And Judah said to Onan, “Go to your brother’s wife and marry her. Then you can also produce offspring for your brother.”
verses.9: And Onan knew that he would not have any seed. He would have to go to his brother’s wife and take her land, so that he could not give seed to his brother.
verses.10: And it displeased the eyes of Jehovah, because of what he had done. And he also died.
verses.11: And Judah said to Tamar, “Your husband shall go back to your father’s house until your son grows up. Then he will be able to marry you.” So Tamar went and settled in her father’s house.
verses.12: And the days grew long, and Shua’s daughter died. Judah was mourned, and Judah wept over his beloved one. His enemy, Hizkiah, became stronger.
verses.13: And he told Tamar, “Look, your husband is coming up to you. He will bring you back to his house.”
verses.14: And her shame covered her face; she became covered in tears. She sat at the entrance of my eyes, which were on the path of destruction. For she saw that her son was growing up, yet he was not given to a woman.
verses.15: And Yehuda saw her, and he considered her to be a beauty, because her face was beautiful.
verses.16: And he went to her and said, “Please come to me. I don’t know where he is.” She replied, “What will you give me in exchange for coming to me?”
verses.17: And he said, “I will send my warriors from among the sheep.” She replied, “If you give me food before I send them out.”
verses.18: And he said, “What is this gift that I give you?” She replied, “Your wedding ring, your necklace, and your bracelet.” He gave them to her. Then she went to him, and he fell in love with her.
verses.19: And she stood up, walked away, and took off her veil from her face. Then she covered herself with her clothes of ignorance.
verses.20: And Judah sent his men of strength to take the grain from the hand of his enemy, the Edomite. But they couldn’t find it.
verses.21: And he asked the people of that place, “Who is this sacred one, that it’s visible on the road?” They replied, “There isn’t any sacred thing here.”
verses.22: And he returned to Judah and said, “I couldn’t find her.” And the people of that place also said, “She wasn’t there at all.”
verses.23: And Judah said, “Take her away, so that she won’t become a burden. Look, I’ve sent this woman to you, but you didn’t find her.”
verses.24: And it happened after three days. Then he told Judah, “Your wife has become pregnant with a son. Now, let’s go and celebrate this news.” But Judah said, “Let’s wait until she gives birth first.”
verses.25: He was found, and she sent them to her husband, saying, “These are gifts from me to him.” He asked, “To whom should these seals, threads, and decorations be given?”
verses.26: And Judah recognized that she was righteous. He said, “She is worthy of being my wife. She will not be given to another man, and she will never be married again.”
verses.27: And it happened that, during her menstrual period, she had cramps in her uterus.
verses.28: And when she was born, he took her in his arms. The midwife took the baby and wrapped her in cloth. He said, “This is the firstborn.”
verses.29: And when he raised his hand again, his brothers rushed out. They said, “What has happened to you? You have caused a disaster.” Then they called out his name: Paretz.
verses.30: And after that, his brother, who was the second in order, also went out. He called his name Zarah.
